standard.summary: 初始步长估计 d0，推荐 1e-6（小值让 D-Adaptation 自己把它长上去）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The initial step-size estimate d0; 1e-6 is recommended (a small value lets D-Adaptation grow it itself).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 初始步长估计 d0，推荐 1e-6（小值让 D-Adapt 从保守开始自适应）。

advanced_en.principle: Initial step-size estimate d0; 1e-6 recommended (a small value lets D-Adapt adapt conservatively at first).
